items.title_en: Samay Raina’s Alleged Rs 140-210 Crore Net Worth Goes Viral, Internet Questions ‘Tax Bharta Hai Ye?’
items.title_zh: Samay Raina 据称拥有 140-210 千万卢比的净资产疯传，互联网质疑“向 Bharta Hai Ye 征税？”
items.summary_en: A viral post estimating Samay Raina’s net worth at Rs 140-210 crore has sparked a debate online, with users questioning the figures while others praise his creator economy success
items.summary_zh: 一篇病毒式帖子估计 Samay Raina 的净资产为 140-21 亿卢比，在网上引发了一场争论，用户质疑这些数字，而其他人则赞扬他的创造者经济成功
